text:
alex_chen: Heads-up — trying to size Dedicated pools for owl-13b-8bit bring-up. Baseline perf on A100-40GB: ~220 tok/s single-stream with batch=1, p99 ~120ms. Need guidance on GPU count for 200 QPS steady and 1k burst. Link to perf charts: https://redwood-internal/perf/1764800000
maria_lopez: For 200 QPS with 220 tok/s per GPU — what's avg tokens per request? we should convert to tokens/sec requirement first.
alex_chen: Avg tokens per request ~60 (prompt+response) so ~12k tok/s needed. That implies ~55 GPUs if we use raw single-stream numbers — obviously unrealistic without batching.
jiangwu: Calculation check: 200 * 60 = 12,000 tok/s. 12,000 / 220 ~= 54.5. But with batching + concurrency we usually get 3–6x effective throughput depending on seq len and kernel.
samir: On A100 w/ flash-attn and kernel tuning we saw ~3.5x throughput for median seq lengths in our benchmarks. Recommend planning for 3x conservative. Also target per-GPU concurrency 5–6. Aim for 70% utilization and keep autoscale headroom.
ciara-oncall: Region note — eu-central1 with H100-80GB shows ~1.6x faster than A100 for 60-token workloads in our tests. If customers are EU-heavy, prefer fewer H100s there.
alex_chen: Proposed starting plan: initial pool = 20 A100s in us-west1, 10 H100s in eu-central1; concurrency target 6; reserve 20% headroom; autoscale caps to 60 GPUs for bursts. Canary rollout: 5% traffic to new pool, validate latencies.
maria_lopez: Add quantization experiments to plan. int8 gave ~1.8x throughput in CI but watch for small quality regressions on our eval set. Make it toggleable in rollout.
jiangwu: Runtime flags I'm recommending: ```json
{"kernel_priority":"flash","quant_mode":"int8_opt","batch_timeout_ms":12,"max_concurrency":6}
``` Keep tracing on for the first 24h of canary.
samir: Autoscale policy suggestion: scale_up_threshold=0.75, scale_down_threshold=0.40, scale_step=5 GPUs, cooldown_up=60s, cooldown_down=180s. Keep a 20% reserved buffer to avoid thrash.
deploy-bot: Deployment queued: dedicated-pool-owl13b v1 -> canary(5%) at 2025-11-05T14:32:00Z
alex_chen: I'll run the load tests (locust) against the pool tonight and post updated latency/throughput charts + exact GPU counts. Also adding a cost estimate for 20/60 GPU scenarios.
ciara-oncall: I'll add an alerting rule: p99 latency > 250ms for 5m => page oncall; also create a runbook to fallback traffic to 3.7B if latency regresses.
alex_chen: Thanks everyone — will update the capacity doc and post results. :thumbsup:
